naslov: A Muslim Is the Brother of a Muslim

segmenti.tekst: Alhamdulillahi Rabbil-'alamin, was-salatu was-salamu 'ala nabiyyina Muhammadin wa 'ala alihi wa sahbihi ajma'in. Praise belongs to Allah alone, the Exalted, subhanahu wa ta'ala, the Lord of all the worlds. May blessings and peace be upon His Messenger, the beloved Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam (peace be upon him), upon his family, upon his companions, and upon all those who follow the path of Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam. Dear brothers, respected members of the congregation, this faith of ours, the din of Islam, teaches us to guard the rights of brotherhood, to guard the right of our Muslim brother,

to love our Muslim brother. The Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, says in a hadith recorded by both Bukhari and Muslim and narrated by Abdullah ibn Umar: "A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim."
Did the Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, stop there? A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim, and that is it, everyone goes his own way? Or is there something more than that?

The Prophet, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, says: "La yazlimuhu" – he does not wrong him. If I am your brother and you are mine, I do not wrong you and you do not wrong me. What is meant by this "he does not wrong him"?
He does not insult him, he does not backbite him, he does not wrong him, he does not spy on him, he protects his property. That is what this "he does not wrong him" means.

The Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, further says: "Wa la yuslimuhu" – he does not hand him over, he does not leave him in the lurch, he does not hand him over to the hungry hyenas. So a Muslim must not allow himself to leave his Muslim brother in the lurch,
to abandon him when things are hardest for him. The Prophet, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, further says: "Man kana fi hajati akhihi, kanallahu fi hajatihi."

Whoever is there for the need of his Muslim brother, helping him, Allah will be there to help him. Allah will be there to help him. So whoever helps his Muslim brother, let him know that Allah will help him.

Let him know that Allah will help him. Did the Prophet, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, stop here, or is there more? There is more. The Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, further says: "Whoever removes some hardship, some difficulty from his Muslim brother" – what happens?

He says: "Allah will remove from him a difficulty from among the difficulties and terrors of the Day of Judgement." So know this: when you help your Muslim brother, when you remove some misfortune, some difficulty, when you see that your brother is in a hard situation and you help him, you rush to his aid… We must not allow ourselves to watch someone among us here suffering, while I sit comfortably at home, masha Allah, nice and warm, and my brother is freezing in his flat.

And my brother needs someone to help him, financially or in any other way – we must not, we must not allow that. Did the Prophet, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, stop here, or is there more? There is more. The Prophet Muhammad, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, further says: "Man satara musliman" – whoever covers the shame of his Muslim brother – and how important this is, dear brothers, by Allah, especially in our time – "satarahullahu yawmal-qiyamah" – Allah will cover his shame on the Day of Judgement.

So when we see one of our Muslim brothers committing some sin, we should not rush straight off to tell this person and that person, and so on. Instead, what should we do? We should cover our Muslim brother. It is different when a person sins openly. Then no one can cover him.

But when we see that a person is committing some hidden sin, go to him and advise him kindly, take him aside somewhere into a corner and say: "Brother, this is not good of you, it is like this and like that." And not in front of everyone, and certainly not in front of everyone. And what is needed? That the shame be covered.
The shame of one's Muslim brother should be covered.
